_comment: THE LONG-HAUL CROSSING FIXTURE (authored 2026-09-02). The type-2 film's beat length must not be set from one distance: ishigaki-crossing is 272 km and 2.6 degrees of longitude, this is 8,732 km and 53.2 degrees, and a constant that suits one makes the aircraft crawl or tear across the other (Docs/cross-region-journeys.md: do not reverse-derive a constant from one trip). Shape: the same short drive across Taipei to Taoyuan airport, an unroutable crossing of the Pacific, then four stops around Auckland and Rotorua. 53.2 degrees is inside crossing_flight_max_longitude_deg (70) and was measured to frame with wide_span_padding intact, both ends at 25% and 75% of the width (LongHaulFrameProbeTests, 2026-09-02). Hand-written plausible coordinates of public places, like every committed fixture — never a real trip (CLAUDE.md §0). The crossing is established by ROUTABILITY, not by its length: UnroutableSeaProvider answers 'no suitable edges' for a leg straddling 150E.
